title.zh: 卡 C-3：NP5-01a C-2 复核观察处置（对称声明词 + 否定 veto + errata 转发）+ C 批 rne/gravity 43 站点 source 级（零 GPU）
title.en: Card C-3: NP5-01a C-2 review observations close-out (symmetric declarations, negated-declaration veto, errata forwarding) + C batch rne/gravity 43 sites source-level (zero GPU)

intent.zh: 第一节承接 C-2 复核 2 观察：①O1 声明词表不对称——QUOTE_DECLARATIONS 补对称集合（中文 撤回/作废/撤销/收回；英文 supersede/withdraw/withdrawn/withdrawal/retract/retracted），并加「块内任一被否定声明词 veto 整个豁免」的保守规则（withdrawn: never supersede 不豁免），docstring 完整列出声明词与否定词表，自测 28→31/31；②O2 将 errata-0001（flex_hessian_validate field-table 滞后）转发到本片 errata_pending（status=forwarded to closing addenda），仅记录不改 field-table 历史。第二节 C-3：rne/gravity 3 组 43 站点（rne_acc 18/gravity_compensation 13/rne_bias 12）source 级：类型映射 + 表达式分类（六类词表，双侧 file:line），自检 43/pending=0/词表合法/policy 扫描 0 命中；NP5-01a 累计 337+43=380。零 GPU、零窗；不改 src/tests/fixtures/判据/参考/容差。
intent.en: Section 1 closes C-2 review: (1) symmetric declaration tokens (Chinese 撤回/作废/撤销/收回; English supersede/withdraw/withdrawn/withdrawal/retract/retracted) plus a conservative negated-declaration veto (withdrawn: never supersede does NOT exempt), docstring lists the full declaration/negator vocabularies, self-tests 28->31/31; (2) forward errata-0001 to this slice's errata_pending (forwarded to closing addenda; field-table history unchanged). Section 2: rne/gravity 43 sites source-level, selfcheck 43/pending=0/policy 0 hits; cumulative 337+43=380. Zero GPU/window.

acceptance: `scripts/np-gate/policy_scan.py` 声明词补对称集合（中文 撤回/作废/撤销/收回；英文 supersede/withdraw/withdrawn/withdrawal/retract/retracted）并加否定声明 veto；docstring 完整列出声明词与否定词；自测 31/31 PASS；sha256/bytes 记入 C-3 evidence。
C-3 evidence/receipt 含 `errata_pending`（errata-0001，status=forwarded to closing addenda errata list；不改 field-table 历史）。

`docs/development-evidence/np-gate/np5-01a-c3/`：evidence.json（43 站点、3 组、类型映射 + 表达式分类 + 双侧 file:line、engine-semantic 1 条含 why 与 bit_level_guarantee:false）、README、receipt（verdict=PASS、site_count=43、pending_manual=0、np5_01a_total_sites=380、section1 两布尔 true、ptx_landed=false）、logs/selfcheck.txt、manifest 逐文件 sha256+bytes 自核；UTF-8/LF 无 BOM。
边界：写域仅 `docs/development-evidence/np-gate/np5-01a-c3/**` + `scripts/np-gate/policy_scan.py` + `.normify/**`；`src/`、`tests/`、`fixtures/` 零改动；零 GPU、零窗；不改判据/参考/容差。
四门禁 + normify check；中文提交。
note: C-2 复核 2 观察（声明词表不对称；errata 清单转发）并入第一节；C-3 为 rne/gravity 43 站点。零 GPU。
